scope: read-only task/rubric and selectively frozen-source review; calibration-expected.json not read; no participant code or network execution

findings.detail: Task explicitly requires returning target host records/readiness and retained quiescence; criterion requires using observations/explaining boundaries but does not require these returned values. C01 with retainedQuiescence omitted from return still meets all six literal inspection criteria. Reading host without returning it similarly evades the required output.
findings.recommendation: Explicitly require returned target host records/readiness and retained quiescence; permit equivalent shapes and unavailable states.

findings.detail: Code comment says distinct names yield distinct input Nodes and resource bindings. Explanation says names do not clone/prepare resources. New name-resource-boundary rule prohibits the former claim; C07 is not an unambiguous positive. C08 inherits the same false comment as well as its explicit negative explanation.
findings.recommendation: If C07 is intended positive, correct its comment before freezing. Keep C08 negative by its deliberately false explanatory claim.

findings.detail: Prompt simultaneously requests explanations (including Explain separately) and says Submit code only. This is inherited from v5 but remains contradictory now that explanation is specifically scored by new name-resource-boundary criterion.
findings.recommendation: Replace Submit code only with Submit code and explanation; do not execute it.

sourceChecks.multipleInstances: Explicit target publication authorityId, absence guard and unfiltered graph snapshot supported by README 98-132, causal-publication.ts 71-79, causal-graded-demo.ts 207-230. No enumeration dependency.
